answer: Lock a voyage deposit before paid work: an agent stakes 500 POA and publishes a beacon hash committing to its delivery before the voyage begins. Step 1: the kernel — the chain — checks the stake and records the beacon. Step 2: the agent finishes the job and reveals the matching proof. Step 3: peers verify the hash; a mismatch forfeits the 500 POA and burns the identity. Step 4: honest agents reclaim it after 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA, lost on the first lie — a $40,000 bonfire. One beacon guides a ship home; a thousand fake beacons burn a thousand ships.
